f.title: Prepare annual summary reports for marketed drugs and NHPs
f.statement: Under the updated summary reporting guidance (effective 1 October 2026), the long-standing requirement for market authorization holders to prepare annual summary reports for marketed drugs and natural health products continues.
f.clause: Updated guidance for summary reporting requirements
f.applicability: Marketed drugs and natural health products

rows.quote: The updates clarify long-standing requirements to prepare annual summary reports
rows.location: Updated guidance for summary reporting requirements
rows.review_note: Review: notice summarises the updated guidance; 'long-standing requirements' read as a continuing legal duty (no regulation cited in the notice). Double-check: kept below 90 as it rests on a notice, not the guidance text.

f.title: Provide annual summary reports to the Minister only on written request
f.statement: Annual summary reports should be provided to the Minister only upon receipt of a written request from Health Canada.
f.clause: Updated guidance for summary reporting requirements
f.applicability: Marketed drugs and natural health products

rows.quote: make clear that annual summary reports should only be provided to the Minister upon receipt of a written request from Health Canada.
rows.location: Updated guidance for summary reporting requirements
rows.review_note: Review: quote checked verbatim; statement faithful; level follows the modal verb. Double-check: no change.

f.title: Notify the Minister of significant changes in known risks and benefits using the new form
f.statement: Market authorization holders notify the Minister of significant changes to what is known about a product's risks and benefits using a new form described in the updated guidance.
f.clause: Updated guidance for summary reporting requirements
f.applicability: Marketed drugs and natural health products
f.systems: Health Canada significant change notification form

rows.quote: The updates also describe how to notify the Minister of significant changes to what is known about the product's risks and benefits, using a new form.
rows.location: Updated guidance for summary reporting requirements
systems: Health Canada significant change notification form
rows.review_note: Review: the notice only describes the guidance; level Recommended as no modal verb in the quote. Double-check: kept below 90.

f.title: Notify Health Canada of a significant change only when the guidance threshold is met
f.statement: Market authorization holders should notify Health Canada of a significant change only if it meets the threshold in the guidance, per the definition, to avoid duplicate and over-reporting.
f.clause: Updated guidance for summary reporting requirements
f.applicability: Marketed drugs and natural health products

rows.quote: These updates also explain that you should notify Health Canada of a significant change only if it meets the threshold outlined in guidance, per the definition.
rows.location: Updated guidance for summary reporting requirements
rows.review_note: Review: quote checked verbatim; statement faithful; level follows the modal verb. Double-check: no change.

dates.title: Health Canada updated summary reports guidance (marketed drugs and NHPs): takes effect
dates.scope: Market authorization holders preparing annual summary reports and significant change notifications for marketed drugs and natural health products
dates.quote: The updated guidance will take effect as of October 1, 2026.
dates.timing_note: Also stated under 'Updated guidance for summary reporting requirements': 'will come into effect on October 1, 2026'. The 23 May 2018 date is the previous version's publication.
